environment.description: Go microservice deployed on EKS cluster (v1.28) in us-east-1 VPC. Pod runs with default service account, no network policies applied. IMDS v1 enabled on nodes (HttpTokens: optional). Service exposed via internal ALB on port 8080. Pod has unrestricted egress. No istio sidecar or envoy proxy. Node IAM role has S3 and DynamoDB access policies attached.

config.network: No NetworkPolicy, default VPC CNI, IMDS v1 accessible at 169.254.169.254
